riddor.heading: RIDDOR
riddor.notScreened: Not yet screened. The determination — including "not reportable" — is itself the defensible record.
riddor.screenHint: The platform computes the deadline; you own the judgement. Pick the category the answers imply and record why.
riddor.notePlaceholder: Why this determination — e.g. 9 days off work following the accident, so over-7-day applies…

help.not_reportable: None of the reportable categories apply. Record why — the negative determination is the record.
help.death: A person died as a result of a work-related accident. Notify without delay; report within 10 days.
help.specified_injury: Fracture (not fingers/toes), amputation, sight loss, crush to head/torso, serious burns, scalping, unconsciousness from asphyxia, or 24h+ hospital admission. Report within 10 days.
help.over_7_day: The worker is incapacitated for more than 7 days, not counting the day of the accident. Report within 15 days of the accident.
help.occupational_disease: A diagnosed occupational disease linked to the work — carpal tunnel, dermatitis, occupational asthma, HAVS, tendonitis, occupational cancer.
help.dangerous_occurrence: A Schedule 2 near-miss event — collapse of lifting equipment, scaffold collapse, electrical fire/explosion, pressure-system failure, accidental release.
help.gas_incident: A gas-related death or injury, or a dangerous gas fitting.
